description: Map corpora the golden scenes render, pinned by digest. ci-local.sh provisions each one the environment does not already point at: `simforge maps pull <map>@<version>` from the public registry into a cache keyed by the release digest (every blob verified against the release's canonical closure), then requires the installed receipt to carry exactly these digests and exports <env> = <cache>/.corpus/<map>. A missing, unreachable or drifted corpus fails the goldens step; nothing is skipped. An <env> set by the caller must hold the same receipt.
